suppress.reason: A changelog describes past releases. Citing code as it was at release time is correct, not rot.
The reference guides use src/ai/brain.ts:301 as an illustrative citation example. It is deliberately not a real path in this repository, and resolving it would be meaningless.
The README opens with a block-art banner spelling the project name, which is the title. GitHub renders the repository name above it, so an H1 would be a third copy of the same word.
GitHub renders a pull-request template as the body of a new PR, where an H1 would become a stray heading in every description. It is a form, not a document.
